verdict.rationale: WezTerm has its own SSH integration: an embedded ssh library gives an integrated client that parses ~/.ssh/config, opens new tabs as channels without re-authenticating, and offers SSH domains that connect to a remote wezterm multiplexer. A community user reports this works well for reconnectable remote sessions. However, nothing in the evidence shows this integration installing terminfo, shell integration, or local config on the remote host, which is the distinctive half of the story. missing for 10: evidence of automatic terminfo propagation to remote hosts, shell-integration bootstrapping over SSH, carrying config to the remote side.
